template.name: Modem Industrial Ensitec Mxx
template.description: Template SNMP para Modems Ensitec Mxx

discovery_rule.name: tagValueEntry Discovery
discovery_rule.description: An entry containing information of a particular tag value. Each tag can have multiple values, which are stored in this table. Each value is usually indexed by unique ID 'tagValueIndex' which is unique for each tag, starting from 0. The 'tagValue' object contains the raw value of the tag, which can be of different data types as specified by the 'tagType' object in the tag entry.

item_prototype.name: tagValue for {#SNMPINDEX}
item_prototype.description: Raw value of the tag value, refer to 'tagType' object for the data type.

item_prototype.name: tagValueIndex for {#SNMPINDEX}
item_prototype.description: Unique index for the tag value entry.

discovery_rule.name: tagEntry Discovery
discovery_rule.description: An entry containing information of a particular tag.

item_prototype.name: tagTimestamp for {#SNMPINDEX}
item_prototype.description: The Unix timestamp of the last time the tag information was updated. This is mainly intended to see when the tagValueTable of this tag was last updated.

item_prototype.name: tagValueSize for {#SNMPINDEX}
item_prototype.description: Number of values in this tag. This is mainly used to see how many values are stored in the 'tagValueTable' for this tag, though it is not guaranteed that the number of values in the table matches this count, as with some data types such as string there will be only one 'tagValueTable' entry.

item_prototype.name: tagIndex for {#SNMPINDEX}
item_prototype.description: Unique index for the tag entry.
